mapper.select: select sn.*, sa.username from sys_notice sn left join sys_admin sa on sa.admin_id = sn.create_by where sn.del_flag = 0 and (#{noticeQuery.noticeTitle} is NULL or sn.notice_title like CONCAT('%',#{noticeQuery.noticeTitle},'%')) and (#{noticeQuery.username} is NULL or sa.username like CONCAT('%',#{noticeQuery.username},'%'))
